_comment: I0 law-enforcement playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). What IC3 accepts from a victim or PI, what the US side can then send to whom, and the evidence it wants. IC3 analyses and refers; only the receiving agency acts. An IC3 complaint ID is context for a provider, never an LE request and never a freeze.
notes: IC3 does not investigate and gives no status; any follow-up comes from the receiving agency (an fbi.gov / usss / state or local .gov address naming an agent and a case number). For time-sensitive matters IC3 says to contact local law enforcement directly. Scammers impersonate IC3: IC3 never contacts victims to recover funds or charges fees.

fbi-ic3.portal.notes: Anyone may file, including on another person's behalf. Complaints cannot be edited: new facts go in a new complaint that says so.

paths.notes: Give every sending and receiving address, full 64-hex transaction hashes, amounts, asset, chain and UTC times, the exchanges used, how the victim met the scammer, communications with names / addresses / numbers, and the scam's domains and apps. An on-screen confirmation ('Your complaint has been successfully submitted'), then no contact from IC3. Save or print the complaint on the confirmation screen: it is the only chance to keep a copy (the FAQ). Keep the complaint reference IC3 shows and quote it in every provider letter.
Recovery Asset Team (Financial Fraud Kill Chain): the RAT asks the receiving bank to freeze a wire. Fiat legs only, and only within days of the transfer; not on-chain crypto.

issues.by: the FBI field office or partner agency that takes the referral (case agent)
issues.notes: Freeze / hold request through the provider's LE channel; Circle acts on a US authority, Tether reports onboarding the FBI and USSS. Exchange holds are short (about two weeks at Binance.US), so the warrant must follow quickly.
Paxos acts only on a formal legal directive from an authority with jurisdiction over it (USDP / PYUSD: Paxos Trust, US); in 2022 it froze PAXG on a US federal law-enforcement direction.

issues.by: a federal magistrate on the case agent's / AUSA's application
issues.notes: Then civil or criminal forfeiture, then remission / restitution to victims (months to years).

issues.by: grand jury subpoena, court order or search warrant (records)
DOJ Criminal Division, Office of International Affairs
issues.notes: For providers outside the US; slow (months).
